title: Guru Gobind Singh Arrives at Dadu Duar

blocks.text: The spectacle around Guru Gobind Singh at Dadu Duar is described in royal and musical terms: instruments sound from every side, attendants circle him, and the astonished town begins to talk openly that the tenth Nanak has arrived.
As the excitement spreads, local people come for darshan and make offerings, and the mahant is moved to open Dadu Duar and come out with his companions to receive the Guru respectfully.
The page turns the Guru’s arrival into a public revelation, with Dadu Duar becoming the stage on which saintly authority, royal bearing, and popular recognition converge.
